snippet.title: Fit and Fry | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #FitandFry

👩‍🍳Fit and Fry Launch Trailer👩‍🍳
🥕 Available for Playstation, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Microsoft Store!

Cooking here is a delicious puzzle. Each level is a new dish to prepare, and your challenge is to fit all the ingredients perfectly into the pan.

KEY FEATURES:
🥕40 levels to test your cooking skills!;
🥕Combine over 15 unique ingredients to master increasingly recipes;
🥕Solve clever puzzles with satisfying drag-and-snap mechanics;
🥕Cook your way through kitchen challenges.

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
👩‍🍳Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014893
👩‍🍳Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/fit-and-fry/9PNC17QWTF67/0010
👩‍🍳Xbox One: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/fit-and-fry-xbox-one/9nnrqr3bcspl
👩‍🍳Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nnz1n1l189n?hl=en-US&gl=US
